source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Pressure the parent toward breastfeeding and discourage discussion of formula feeding","B":"Withhold formula-feeding information so the parent is more likely to choose breastfeeding","C":"Use one standard script without adapting counseling to the parent's needs or preferences","D":"Provide accurate feeding information and support the parent's informed, individualized choice"}}
source_row.rationale: While breastfeeding has well-established health benefits, best practice for infant feeding counseling involves providing accurate, evidence-based information about both breastfeeding and formula feeding, and supporting the parent's informed decision based on their individual circumstances, health factors, and personal preferences, respecting parental autonomy.
source_row.source_detail: 2022 AAP policy statement: clinicians support breastfeeding while providing family-centered counseling and respecting individual circumstances; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: American Academy of Pediatrics — Breastfeeding and the Use of Human Milk
